name: Toyo Tire Corporation
summary: Toyo Tire Corporation makes and distributes tires in Japan and globally, with tires for cars, SUVs, pickup trucks, commercial trucks and buses sold under the Toyo Tires and Nitto brands. It also produces automotive components, including suspension parts, CVJ boots, and mounts for engines and motors. Dating from 1943 as Toyo Tire & Rubber Co., Ltd., it was renamed in January 2019 and has its head office in Itami, Japan.
